 Uzbekistan’s Pakhtakor FC will host Saudi Arabia’s Al Nassr in an AFC Champions League Elite 2026-27 group-stage fixture on Monday.
 Both placed in Group B, the Uzbek side sits 12th after three games, still searching for its first win of the campaign after losing twice and drawing once. Meanwhile, the Cristiano Ronaldo-led Al Nassr is in ninth place, having played a game less. It has won once and drawn the other time.
 LIVE STREAMING INFO
 When is the Pakhtakor FC vs Al Nassr AFC Champions League Elite 2026-27 group-stage match? 
 The Pakhtakor FC vs Al Nassr AFC Champions League Elite 2026-27 group-stage match will kick off at 7:15pm IST (6:45pm local time) at the Pakhtakor Central Stadium in Tashkent on Monday.
 Where to watch the Pakhtakor FC vs Al Nassr AFC Champions League Elite 2026-27 group-stage match LIVE? 
 The Pakhtakor FC vs Al Nassr AFC Champions League Elite 2026-27 group-stage match will be streamed on the Fancode platform.
